voice.persona: Zack D Films style fast punchy narrator, energetic and objective tone

music: fast ticking clock and rising bass riser into punchy energetic beat

beats.narration: In 1814, a literal 15-foot tidal wave of beer smashed through the streets of London...

shots.scene: vintage 1800s London map and sketch overlaid with violent liquid amber splash and torn paper edges
shots.element_motion: map zooms rapidly, paper edges rip, dark amber beer foam violently splashes across cobblestone illustration

beats.narration: ...when a massive brewery vat exploded, releasing over 300,000 gallons into the city...

shots.scene: chaotic vintage woodcut of massive exploding wooden brewery vats and surge of dark beer tidal wave
shots.element_motion: wooden staves splinter, beer wave surges forward across paper cut-out buildings, halftone dots flash

beats.narration: ...and people literally tried to drink the street dry because...

shots.scene: vintage 1814 newspaper clipping and paper cut-outs of crowd gathering with mugs in flooded street
shots.element_motion: newspaper headline flashes with subtle glitch effect, crowd figures shift, hard loop back to start
